nodes.logic: const approved=new Set(['chris@garagebaggerstereo.com','ethan@garagebaggerstereo.com','sales@garagebaggerstereo.com','support@garagebaggerstereo.com','garagebaggerstereo@gmail.com']);function addr(x){if(typeof x==='string')return (x.match(/<([^>]+)>/)?.[1]||x).trim().toLowerCase();return String(x?.emailAddress?.address||'').trim().toLowerCase()}return $input.all().map(item=>{const e=item.json||{};const hdr=e.headers||e.payload?.headers||[];const hv=(n)=>Array.isArray(hdr)?(hdr.find(h=>String(h.name||'').toLowerCase()===n.toLowerCase())?.value||''):(Object.entries(hdr).find(([k])=>k.toLowerCase()===n.toLowerCase())?.[1]||'');const from=addr(e.from||e.From||hv('from'));const tos=Array.isArray(e.toRecipients)?e.toRecipients.map(addr):[addr(e.to||e.To||hv('to'))];const refs=String(hv('references')||'').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);const root=refs[0]||String(hv('in-reply-to')||'').trim()||null;const mid=e.internetMessageId||hv('message-id')||null;const sentRaw=e.sentDateTime||e.internalDate||e.date||hv('date')||null;const normalizedTo=tos.filter(Boolean);const sentAt=sentRaw&&/^\d{12,}$/.test(String(sentRaw))?new Date(Number(sentRaw)).toISOString():sentRaw;const sentMs=Date.parse(String(sentAt||''));const recent=Number.isFinite(sentMs)&&sentMs>=Date.now()-36*3600000&&sentMs<=Date.now()+300000;const eligible=approved.has(from)&&normalizedTo.length===1&&!approved.has(normalizedTo[0])&&recent;return {json:{sourceProvider:e.internetMessageId?'outlook':'gmail',sourceMessageId:e.id||null,rfcMessageId:mid,threadRootMessageId:root,references:hv('references')||null,inReplyTo:hv('in-reply-to')||null,providerConversationId:e.conversationId||e.threadId||null,from,to:normalizedTo[0]||null,sentAt,subject:e.subject||e.Subject||'',body:e.body?.content||e.text||e.snippet||'',candidate:!!eligible,noOutboundActions:true}};}).filter(x=>x.json.candidate);
